info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizdoc-List Mortgage Loans Payoffs-v2-spec
info.description: The Mortgage Loans Payoff List API provides access to a comprehensive overview of mortgage loans eligible for payoff. This endpoint facilitates users in retrieving detailed lists of loans, allowing lenders and financial institutions to efficiently manage payoff requests. Ideal for loan officers and financial analysts, the API supports operational needs such as tracking loan statuses and calculating payoff amounts. Users can easily integrate this API to enhance their loan management systems and improve customer service responses.

get.description: Fetches the details regarding the payoff amount for a specific loan. This endpoint allows users to understand their total payoff obligations, including any potential fees or interest calculations.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to initiate a payoff operation for loans. It expects a JSON payload that outlines the specifics of the loan payoff request.
